review_comment: `.setSize(...)` drops out here (and a few other places) -- is that okay?

Some places only needed the count (so size=0 was fine), and some wanted the single record (so size=1 was fine). Since we always expect either 0 or 1 documents in this index it didn't seem to cause any problems to just use the default size. Worst case, we pull back a single history document that we don't care about that gets immediately garbage collected. It avoided passing an argument into this method that might just add confusion.
